kicker: Cervical Cancer · Sci Rep 2025;15:17684 · Retrospective Cohort
kicker_zh: 宫颈癌 · Sci Rep 2025;15:17684 · 回顾性队列
title: PAX1/JAM3 Methylation in Predicting Pathological Upgrading Before Conization
title_zh: PAX1/JAM3 甲基化预测锥切前病理升级
subtitle: 88 CIN patients undergoing conization — ΔCtPAX1 < 4.34 predicts pathological upgrading; model AUC 0.818
subtitle_zh: 88 例接受锥切的 CIN 患者——ΔCtPAX1 < 4.34 提示病理升级风险；模型 AUC 0.818
authors: Chen X, Xu H, Zhao L, Jiang H, Shou H
authors_zh: 陈晓燕, 徐虎滨, 赵灵琴, 蒋海明, 寿华锋

panels.title: Why this study
bullets: Gap: CIN lesions are often upgraded on conization pathology — predicting this before surgery could avoid incomplete or excessive procedures.
Question: can PAX1/JAM3 methylation predict pathological upgrading before conization?
Why it matters: a pre-op methylation read-out supports individualized surgical decisions (LEEP vs CKC).
bullets_zh: 空白：CIN 病变常在锥切病理中升级——术前预测可避免手术不足或过度。
问题：PAX1/JAM3 甲基化能否在锥切前预测病理升级？
意义：术前甲基化读数支持个体化手术决策（LEEP vs CKC）。

panels.title: Cohort & methods
bullets: Design: retrospective cohort (Dec 2020–Apr 2022); Zhejiang Provincial People's Hospital; 88 of 549 screened.
Groups: 18 pathological upgrading vs 70 non-upgrading after LEEP/CKC.
Methylation: ΔCtPAX1/ΔCtJAM3 (NMPA Class III kit) before conization.
Analysis: logistic regression + predictive model (ROC, calibration, DCA).
bullets_zh: 设计：回顾性队列（2020.12–2022.4）；浙江省人民医院；549 例中筛出 88 例。
分组：LEEP/CKC 后病理升级 18 例 vs 未升级 70 例。
甲基化：锥切前 ΔCtPAX1/ΔCtJAM3（NMPA Ⅲ类试剂盒）。
分析：Logistic 回归 + 预测模型（ROC、校准、DCA）。

panels.title: Headline results
bullets: Independent predictors: ΔCtPAX1 (OR 0.784, P=0.016) and endocervical involvement/ECC+ (OR 3.469, P=0.048).
Model: AUC 0.818 (0.720–0.916) with specificity 94.4% / sensitivity 60%.
Cut-off: ΔCtPAX1 < 4.34 → high upgrading risk (upgraded 3.51±2.32 vs non-upgraded 9.26±6.64).
Validation: calibration MAE 0.031; DCA net benefit in 0–0.3 threshold range.
bullets_zh: 独立预测因子：ΔCtPAX1（OR 0.784，P=0.016）与宫颈管内受累/ECC+（OR 3.469，P=0.048）。
界值：ΔCtPAX1 < 4.34 → 升级风险高（升级组 3.51±2.32 vs 未升级 9.26±6.64）。
验证：校准 MAE 0.031；DCA 在 0–0.3 阈值区间有净获益。

panels.title: Clinical value
bullets: Pre-op decision aid: identifies women likely to have CIN2+ on final pathology — informs one-step vs staged surgery.
High specificity: 94.4% — few false alarms, safe to plan conservative management when negative.
Complementary: combines with ECC status to refine risk in the conization population.
bullets_zh: 术前决策辅助：识别最终病理可能为 CIN2+ 的女性——指导一步式 vs 分步手术。
高特异度：94.4%——假警报少，阴性时保守处理安全。
互补：与 ECC 状态联合，细化锥切人群的风险评估。

takeaway.title: Take-away
bullets: Methylation predicts upgrading: ΔCtPAX1 < 4.34 flags pathological upgrading before conization (AUC 0.818).
Better surgical planning: high specificity (94.4%) supports individualized LEEP vs CKC decisions.
bullets_zh: 甲基化预测升级：ΔCtPAX1 < 4.34 在锥切前提示病理升级（AUC 0.818）。
更优手术规划：高特异度（94.4%）支持 LEEP vs CKC 的个体化决策。

kicker: Cervical Cancer · Eur J Cancer 2026;243:116823 · Systematic Review & Meta-analysis
kicker_zh: 宫颈癌 · Eur J Cancer 2026;243:116823 · 系统评价与Meta分析
title: Diagnostic Accuracy of DNA Methylation Tests for High-Grade CIN and Cervical Cancer
title_zh: DNA 甲基化检测诊断高级别 CIN 与宫颈癌的准确性
subtitle: 125 studies / 49,242 women — JAM3 top DOR 20.82; PAX1 DOR 17.13 for CIN3+ in hrHPV+ women
subtitle_zh: 125 项研究 / 49,242 例女性——JAM3 最高 DOR 20.82；hrHPV+ 女性 CIN3+ 中 PAX1 DOR 17.13

panels.title: Scope
bullets: Design: systematic review + bivariate random-effects meta-analysis (CRD42022299760, searched to Mar 2025).
Evidence base: 125 studies / 49,242 women; primary analysis 51 studies / 28,977 hrHPV+ women with 13 methylation markers.
Outcomes: CIN2+/CIN3+/invasive cancer diagnostic accuracy.
bullets_zh: 设计：系统评价 + 双变量随机效应 meta 分析（CRD42022299760，检索至 2025.3）。
证据基础：125 项研究 / 49,242 例女性；主要分析 51 项 / 28,977 例 hrHPV+ 女性、13 个甲基化标志物。
结局：CIN2+/CIN3+/浸润癌诊断准确性。

panels.title: Headline findings
bullets: JAM3: highest DOR 20.82 for CIN3+ in hrHPV+ women (sens 74% / spec 88%).
C13ORF18: DOR 19.50 (61% / 93%); PAX1: DOR 17.13 (71% / 87%).
S5 classifier: highest sensitivity 84% (spec 47%).
EPB41L3: lowest negative LR 0.26 → post-test probability 1.35% in low-risk scenarios.
bullets_zh: JAM3：hrHPV+ 女性 CIN3+ 最高 DOR 20.82（灵敏度 74% / 特异度 88%）。
C13ORF18：DOR 19.50（61% / 93%）；PAX1：DOR 17.13（71% / 87%）。
S5 分类器：灵敏度最高 84%（特异度 47%）。
EPB41L3：阴性似然比最低 0.26 → 低风险场景检验后概率 1.35%。

panels.title: Context & limits
bullets: All-population: combined PAX1/JAM3 reached DOR 76.00 for CIN2+ — the highest dual-gene performance.
Rule-out value: 76.9% of markers had <2% post-test probability in low-risk scenarios.
Evidence grade: low-to-moderate certainty (JAM3 moderate); high-quality screening cohorts still needed.
bullets_zh: 全人群：PAX1/JAM3 联合检测 CIN2+ DOR 达 76.00——双基因联合表现最高。
排除价值：76.9% 的标志物在低风险场景检验后概率 <2%。
证据等级：低–中确定性（JAM3 为中等）；仍需高质量筛查队列验证。

takeaway.title: Take-away
bullets: Methylation validated broadly: JAM3/PAX1 among the top markers for CIN3+ in hrHPV+ women (DOR 17–21).
PAX1/JAM3 dual-gene: DOR 76.00 for CIN2+ — strong evidence for clinical adoption, pending cohort validation.
bullets_zh: 甲基化获广泛验证：JAM3/PAX1 位列 hrHPV+ 女性 CIN3+ 顶级标志物（DOR 17–21）。
PAX1/JAM3 双基因：CIN2+ DOR 76.00——为临床采纳提供有力证据，尚待队列验证。
